steps.minor: Lower the middle note of a major chord by one key (a semitone) and it becomes minor, with a darker sound: {cMajor} has {e}, {cMinor} has {eb}, the black key just below.
steps.majorMinor: Switch between {cMajor} and {cMinor}: only the middle finger moves. Listen to the change of color.
steps.whiteMinors: Three minor chords use only white keys: {dMinor}, {eMinor} and {aMinor}. The hand shape is the same as for major chords; the middle note is one key lower than in the major chord.
steps.progression: A short progression mixing major and minor chords: {cMajor}, {aMinor}, {dMinor}, {gMajor} and back to {cMajor}, in time.
